caption: The drawing depicts a small statue of an angel rendered in shades of beige, brown, and gray. The angel is shown in a kneeling position atop a square, multi-tiered pedestal. The figure has short hair, and both arms are bent with hands held near the chest. The angel has a pair of detailed wings extending from its back, with lines indicating feathers. The surface of the statue and pedestal is uneven, and shading is used to give a sense of volume and depth. The background is plain and light-colored, providing contrast to the statue and allowing its contours to be clearly visible.
title: Figurine
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
